title: Great performance, a bit of weird UI
text:
Performance is fantastic on capable devices, and the game supports up to 120fps and controllers. 

UI is weird sometimes. When fishing with touch controls, the fish will appear at the last place you tapped which is likely on the left side of the screen. You then have to drag it to the right side to place it in your inventory. Why doesn’t it just appear in the inventory for you to adjust?

When rotating a fish in your inventory, you get three options: Place, Rotate, Discard. If the fish is in an area of your inventory that it can’t be placed in, the Discard option takes the same position that Rotate just occupied. If you’re looking at the fish and not the buttons to the left of it, you could accidentally discard the fish instead of rotating it. The game sorta resolves this by making you tap and hold on Discard, but I find myself frequently having to check where I’m tapping. The three options could be designed to occupy the same place on the screen and Place can simply disappear when it’s not an option instead of Rotate and Discard shifting upward. 

“Back” at the bottom right is made more for a mouse cursor than for touch. It’s pretty small and you have to tap directly on it when you’re in a menu. If you’re using touch controls, a touch-based button should be a little larger, perhaps more like the menu options I mentioned above. 

There’s a few other weird things in the game, like how with some NPC requests you just have to remember where to resolve them, they may not show up in Core Pursuits. I don’t expect the game to hand-hold a ton, but some general guidance on fishing locations or a mark on the map would have been more helpful, especially as the game goes on and the novelty begins to wear.

title: Nothing wrong except for the people who hate it (and a bit pricey)
text: There is absolutely no reason why people should be leaving this game a one star. Sure, it’s not for everyone, especially with the intense scenes and the eerie story, but come on. Just because you have to do a little extra work to get around the map and organize your boat and all that doesn’t immediately make it a bad game. Just because people don’t like the immersion doesn’t mean they have to blab their mouths about it. One common theme as well is complaints about pricing, and come on. It literally says in the description in all caps and bolded, “PAY BEFORE YOU PLAY” just under the in game purchases where the base game is clearly listed as the first purchase. I do agree that the price can be steep for some people, but I think it’s worth it for the amount of rich story there is to discover. Outstanding game, and I hope to play more of your guys’ work in the future!

title: A reel incredible game that you can sink hours into. Well worth the price!
text:
The gameplay loop is simple, yet entrancing. You maneuver your tiny boat through a little alcove, reeling up any fish you see and strategically placing them in your ships cargo. You will return to port, sell your fish, and upgrade your boat. Then you take to the seas again! This time you have a stronger engine, brighter lights, more fishing nets, and bigger cargo hold. You discover more fish, and find intriguing new islands with mysteries to uncover. 

I played this game on the initial PC release and was immediately hooked by its charm! The art style lends itself perfectly to the themes of the story. The gameplay loop is repetitive, but somehow strikes a perfect balance of being engaging and refreshing enough to not get stale through the many zones of the game. There are so many hidden secrets to discover, that there is never a dull moment! When I saw that Dredge was coming to mobile, I immediately preordered the game and have been eagerly waiting since it was announced! 

Initially I was hesitant on how the controls would port to mobile since I initially played with a controller. I was so pleasantly relieved and surprised just how natural it feels to play this game on a touch screen! Albeit, the controls are fairly simple for this game, it just works so seamlessly on mobile. 

Overall, this is a top-tier game with one of the best stories in entertainment/media. The gameplay is easy to pick up, and extremely engaging; all the way up to the last moments of the game. I couldn't recommend this game more!

title: One of the best games i’ve ever played
text:
At first glance this game seems like a cozy fishing game. You sail around a quiet archipelago, casting your line, upgrading your boat, and selling your haul to friendly locals. But it doesn’t take long for things to feel off. Shadows move where they shouldn’t, the water churns in unnatural ways, and the further you venture from safety, the more you start to wonder if you should have stayed in port.

This game absolutely nails atmosphere. During the day, the world is serene. soft waves, golden sunlight, the satisfying loop of fishing and upgrading. But as night falls, a creeping dread sets in. Thick fog rolls over the ocean, hiding things you’d rather not see. Strange lights flicker in the distance, tempting you off course. And when your panic starts to rise, so does the risk of disaster.

The mix of fishing, exploration, and light horror works brilliantly. Upgrading your boat and discovering new, increasingly unsettling fish is rewarding, and the game always pushes you to venture a little farther than you should. The writing is subtle but effective—every character has a story, every island has secrets, and piecing together the eerie lore is just as fun as the gameplay itself.

Visually, DREDGE is stunning in a simple, painterly way, and the sound design is top-tier. The creak of your boat, the distant wail of something unknown, the sudden silence that makes you feel like you’re being watched—it all adds to the tension without ever feeling forced.

What makes DREDGE special is how it lingers in your mind. It’s not an in-your-face horror game, but that sense of unease never really leaves. It’s just you, your boat, and the dark, endless sea. And something is waiting beneath the waves.

title: Own Dredge and all add-ons on XBOX.  I was invited to the Beta testing.
text: Overall, they did a pretty great job porting over the game to a mobile version.  Since the Beta (prior to 1.0 release), they still had a few controller button prompts missing, and the touch screen controls, particularly in the inventory, feel quite clunky.  I also hope they improve the UI needs for customizing your vessel on Little Marrows, as those menus can be both slow and confusing (especially without visual representations of each Flag and Color options).  All of the necessary components from the expansions and the base game were handled really well for the mobile version, and it still feels just like Dredge.

title: Fantastic game
text: I’m 28, and at this stage of my life I often find it difficult to come across a game that truly captivates me and feels worthy of my limited free time, especially while working 40+ hours a week. Yet every time I come home, I find myself starting up Dredge and sinking (pun intended) at least an hour or two into it. During that time, I completely disconnect from everything else going on in my life and immerse myself fully in the game. I really want to thank the team for putting so much love and passion into Dredge it’s something I feel deeply while playing, and it’s a quality I find missing in many modern games.

title: Promising atmosphere, tedious and lacking in substance
text:
I love the mechanics of the boat, and the atmosphere. However, the fishing mechanic is boring, the mechanic of trying to fit things on the boat is also tedious, the puzzles are very straightforward or if not straightforward, not interesting to solve. The story seems like it’s going to be interesting, but the conclusion has several holes. Several very uninteresting side plots and stories - why should I care about them? I just wanted to get to the end of the game, but I felt like I was being dragged on and on.
And as for the horror element, it’s pretty easy to avoid the horror. Which I don’t mind necessarily… but I think the predictability makes it boring.

2 stars because I don’t appreciate the amount of time I spent on meaningless side quests in the game.

総評

title: スマホでの操作について：既プレイ勢(Switch)
text:
Switch版でファンになった者です。スマホにて最初の釣りを終えたので、操作についてフィードバックします。

①船の操縦
画面左側で船の操縦、画面右側で視点の操作を行うため、Switchのプロコンと似た操作性があり馴染みました。

②カメラワーク
船が進むのに合わせてカメラワークがグラグラ動くため、画面酔いしやすいです。デフォルトの設定だとカメラワークの視点がかなり揺さぶられ、遠くの景色に焦点を合わせにくく画面が見ずらくなりました。

③魚の配置方法
Switch版と同様に｢魚を選択→持ち上げる→魚を動かす→魚を置く｣の手順で操作しますが、ボタン操作で快適だったこの手順が、スマホ画面の操作では手順が多く煩わしく感じました。ホールド、ドラッグ、スワイプの操作を使って手際よく魚を動かしたいと思いました。

④｢進む｣｢戻る｣などのボタン
スマホ画面の右下にあるボタンですが、かなり小さく押しずらい印象があります。手が大きい方はiPadでの操作をオススメします。

⑤全体の印象
改良の余地を感じ、星3つとしました。

Switch版のプロコン操作をそのままスマホに落とし込んだ感じでした。まだ序盤ですが、スマホならではの操作は無いかもしれません。

また、テレビ画面で親しんだDREDGEの世界がそのままスマホ画面にギュッと収まっているので、図鑑などの文字が大変小さいです。魚に添えれたフレーバーテキストがお気に入りのため、読みやすい大きさに変更できるといいなと思いました。

title: めちゃ良かった
text:
まずこのゲーム、個人的には大満足だった。いい所としてやっぱり綺麗なUIとキャラクターデザイン、細かいところのデザインや登場人物の独特な不気味さなど、自分の中で歴代の好きなスマホゲームtop3に入るほどに面白いと感じた。しかも釣りもただ同じものが釣れるのではなく、奇形の魚が釣れることもありそこも全て収集したくなるほどコレクター心をくすぐってくれた。

難点としては少ないながら2つほど挙げたい。

①ストーリーの長さ
他のレビューで言及している方もいる通り、少しだけストーリーを短いと感じてしまう人はいると思った。正直自分からすると全然そうは感じなかったが、ガッツリと何週間もやるタイプのゲームであることは承知して頂きたい。

②端末への負荷
これもまた言及している人が何人か見られるが、端末が熱くなりやすいゲームであると感じた。自分の使っている端末はiPhone13proであるが、他のゲームをやっていてもそうそう熱くなることはない。(少し前にやっていたwarzoneという端末不可の大きいfps以外はほとんど熱さを感じない)
それでもこのゲームは設定次第とはいえ割と頻繁に熱くなる印象がある。特に充電しながらは要注意である。とはいえ画質やフレームレートを下げればいい話なので、そこまで留意する点では無いのかな、と思った。

最後に

ここまで読んでいる人は少なからず購入を検討している人が多いと思う。でも声を大にして言いたいのは、このゲームを買うか迷ったら是非購入してやってみて欲しいということだ。普段全くこういったレビューは書かないが、あまりにゲームとしての完成度が高くスマホゲームとしては申し分ないほどのクォリティを誇っているためここに書かせていただいた。
そしてこのゲームはpcでもできるのでもしそっちが可能なら検討もあり。

長々とお付き合い頂きありがとうございました。

title: Good for a While

title: THIS GAME IS AWESOME (but one annoying glitch…)
text:
First of all, I would like to say this is the best game ever. There is so much to do and even though I just started playing, I get the sense that I might never run out of content. The characters are interesting and they all make actual sense, which some characters in other games don’t. The characters in Stardew valley don’t contradict themselves, and their ‘heart events’ that reveal more about them are one of my favorite parts of the game, in addition to the forest near the wizard tower. 
But…for 1 WHOLE STARDEW VALLEY WEEK I was stuck in my house due to some random wilderness golem standing on my doorstep. (I had never seen one before so I had to look this up.) Thankfully I had the sword on me so the first time I went outside I didn’t get instantly killed bc I turned on auto attack. But now I have A LOT of quests, and I’m terrified to be outside my house when I’m not in town because of the wilderness golem thing. 
Speaking of quests, there are like 3000 fishing related quests and I accidentally threw away my fishing rod. But that’s something I did not something wrong with the game. 
Aside from the wilderness golem incident and my fishing rod being gone, this game is amazing and I will probably recommend it to everyone I know who owns any electronic device that Stardew is playable on. This game is amazing and whoever created this is an absolute genius because this game is great.

title: I love this game, minor changes needed for best experience
text: I do adore this game, I have played it on my friends switch for hours on end after them went to bed and even when they were awake. When I herd it was coming to mobile I was stoked, I immediately preordered and the moment it was out I was downloading. I began to play and noticed differences in controls, when I started playing there were three things I would change. Not having to switch between tools, it was in the right place it’s a wonderful mechanic, until your trying to water your crops and you accidentally use your pickaxe and destroy it. Smaller screen, once again in the right place a smaller screen smaller window right? As someone who likes to see more especially with such vast spaces like the woods a bigger area that you can see is preferred, if there were perhaps an option to scale this in any way that would be perfect. Some things take more time, compared to the switch at least. One of the things I loved about the switch was just being able to throw things into the deposit box. When I noticed this ability had been removed I was saddened partly due to inside jokes but mainly because it saved time being able to run by and throw things was easier then having to open a menu and select from there. Anyway those are just three small things I would be so happy if were changed but these things wouldn’t keep me from this game ever. It’s such a fun and immersive game that just steals your attention, it’s fantastic.

title: Love the game, but the bugs are frustrating.
text:
I’m just as obsessed with Stardew Valley as the next person. It’s become my hyper fixation again recently. Before, I would play on my phone and just use touch controls. When I heard that switch joycons could be connected to your iPad I was so stoked. I’ve been playing a new save and trying to romance/develop friendships with characters as one does. I got to a cut scene with Sebastian today and as soon as I was tasked with making decisions, the game froze and I was unable to do anything. A refresh of the app just starts the day over, and it’s the same story whenever I tried to go back into the cut scene. It’s super inconvenient as I feel like I’m missing out on some of the story if I just continue the game and try to avoid cut scenes. I’ve also noticed how changing between a consumable and a tool or just any other item too quickly freezes the time and your character. Often you can still switch between items in the inventory but you are unable to use them. A little way I’ve been able to work around that is always carrying a sword and swinging it whenever I’m frozen. That usually makes the game playable again, but it’s kinda irritating. Much love to the team as I know maintaining a game with so much content can’t be easy. I would really appreciate it if these bugs were looked at. 
Thanks!

title: In Love
text: I adore this game for multiple reasons, I discovered it with friends and bonded over it, it isn’t a repeat of every other mobile game out there, no in-app purchases, only one for the full game, and the story and NPC’s are written beautifully into the world. I’m currently on year five and have logged about 125 hours into one save, I have experienced it all in this game and I can tell you it never gets stale, because when you finish building your farm you can then build up relationships with the townspeople, and after that, you can finish the community quests and after that you can find secrets and rare items. So on and so on, you can find everything to do in the game and even replay it over again as there are two paths you can take in game that effect the town and how you play the game. The controls are easy and simple so it’s great for inexperienced players or people that want a relaxing experience that can take them on an adventure. title: この世界を変えるのはプレイヤーだけ
text:
「いまさらドット三等身で牧場ゲーム？」という初見の抵抗感は、一年目の夏を迎える頃にはさっぱり消えてしまう。

自分はすっかりこの谷の住人になり、毎晩「明日は〇〇しよう」とワクワクしながら眠りにつくのだ。

夜の帳が下りると、灯りも何もない田舎。一歩先も見えない暗闇と、あたりはしんと静まり返り、虫の音や動物の声だけが響く。

雨もいい。外には動物や人の姿もまばらで、世界は灰色に染まり、雨音だけが優しく包み込む。

店に入ると、親切な隣人が「びしょ濡れじゃない！」と心配してくれるのだ。自分が傘もささずに歩いていたことに気づき、何とも嬉しい気持ちになる。

このゲームの最も優れたところは、そのゲームデザインにある。

何をしてもしなくても、一日はリアルタイム約14分で終了し、28日経てば季節は巡る。

この時間こそが、プレイヤーに強制された唯一のものと言って良い。

プレイヤーはこの限られた時間を何に使ってもいい。作物を育ててピクルスやワインを作っても、牛や鶏を太らせてもいい。森の湖で釣り糸を垂らしても、山の奥地で危険な炭鉱堀りにあけくれてもいい。

自然に疲れたら、村で友情を育んだり、恋をして家庭を築いてもいい。

もちろんただ散歩したり本を読んだり、寝て過ごしてもいい。（それでも毎日何かしらの変化があるので、十分楽しい。）

この世界を変えるのはプレイヤーのアクションだけだ。

自分が何もしなければ、牧場も村もそのまま。誰も変わらないし歳をとることもない。

そこが絶妙なプレッシャーなのだ。

ストレスになるようなシステム（仕事や時限イベントなど）は（ほとんど）なく、一方でプレイヤーのアクションにはいつでも応えてくれる。

楽園と言っても過言ではない。

それでいて、ゲームの目的を見失うことがない。

序盤はクエストという形で進め方を上手くガイドされ、中盤は慣れが飽きに変わる絶妙なタイミングで新要素をアンロックしてくる。

終盤にもなると、難易度の高いやり込みが必要になってくるが、その頃には何をすればいいのか分かってくる。

違う顔、違う牧場で、新しい人生を歩き始めてもいいし。

ひとつひとつの体験を大切に楽しみながら、この世界にゆっくりいつまでも浸っていたい。

title: Blast from the past
text:
I loved the original ridiculous fishing, so I immediately had to download and play this one. After making it to the end the first time, I have to say that it is definitely as fun as the original. The guns, the fish, the gameplay, the updated graphics, it’s all great. However, like all new games, it needs a few updates and bug fixes. 

For starters, there should be an option to calibrate the hook or an option for different controls. Too many times the hook would move more drastically than how I tilted, or it would jump from one end to the other, and that definitely cost me a few good fish. Any slight movements tilting the phone forward or backward also moves the hook dramatically. If there is a specific way the phone should be held, it wasn’t made known. An option to calibrate, if possible, might help to stabilize a user’s preferred phone position when they’re playing. Another bug came from the uzi, at one point the uzi would shoot for me randomly or it wouldn’t shoot where I was aiming unless I touched the screen a few times. However after closing the game and waiting awhile it seemed to fix itself.

The game is also a battery killer. I’m running on the IPhone 13, and it melts through battery life and has my phone burning up. It definitely needs more optimization.

Overall, I’m excited to fill the fishopedia and see what else the game has to offer! I hope to see some more bug fixes and tweaks to the game overall.

title: Lacking polish and impacting gameplay
text:
I was a massive fan of the original and I am a massive fan of this game, but the bugs and polish fixes that still exist after over a month on arcade are giving me pause.
This game doesn’t work consistently, and I don’t think consistency is a big ask for some of the biggest names in indie mobile development. The game is prone to pauses and lag at critical moments, not logging earned achievements, and giving false notifications. 
The pro tour, which I was extremely excited fir as a veteran player, is one of the worst offenders in lack of polish destroying gameplay. Every 3-4 pro tour casts I have are disrupted by the menu popping up, the notification bubble for it is always on even if I have caught every available fish (often masking actual achievements), and on at least two occasions the goals for the day have been logically impossible to complete. 
While I was able to put up with this due to my excitement for this remake, it doesn’t seem like ridiculous fishing will be seeing much replay until these issues get fixed.

title: Almost Great!
text:
This review is for discerning players (aka players who want reviews on mechanics, balance, etc).

Mechanics:
The game premise is fantastic with a solid core loop. (1) Avoid fish to get as deep as you can, (2) catch fish on your way back up, (3) shoot fish out of the air to get cash, (4) upgrade your equipment to help you get deeper.

Plot:
There is very little here. Focus is definitely on the loop of fishing. There is a bit of fluff that gave me high hopes initially, but ultimately didn't deliver -- such as "BikBok," a social media in-game app that clues you into some of the other fishers in the world. Devs, you could make a whole subplot here to reward paying attention! As it is, reading the few in-game posts and comments didn't enhance my experience.

Length:
I wanted much, much more here. Daily and challenge modes don't have much in terms of incentivized progression, so once the main story is done, it feels natural to simply put the game away. That's a bummer because the mechanics are very fun. More islands, deeper max depths, rare fish that don't depend on obscure conditions. This could easily double as an optional "collectible fish game" that rewards campaign progression. As it is, it feels like collecting is a time-waster rather than a core premise of the game.

Final Thoughts:
Very fun game with a short, almost transient feel. Works well as a jump-in-jump-out game, while feeling like it wants more than what's included.

title: Fantastic Remake, Needs Love
text:
This game brought back great memories. The use of 3D models for the fish adds a modern touch that makes collecting the fish exciting all over again. Love the new game mechanic with the maelstrom and the increased rarity of fish as you continue to “prestige”.

Unfortunately, the game has been out for only a month now but it has two critical issues which, in my opinion, were worthy of a quick hotfix:

1. Catching the City of Gold Fish is bugged and it forces you to restart the game. The fish hooks but drags away from your lure as you ascend while stretching itself out. This results in the fish not being thrown into the air while your other fish do. You end up stuck staring at your boat waiting for fish that will never fall back down. This prevents the completion of multiple achievements and honestly spoils the fun.

2. The Pro Fishing mode has been broken since the most recent update for me and my partner on separate devices, separate phone carriers, separate iPhone models. When you load the pro fishing mode, it tells you to check your internet connection.

With these two errors, any reason to play the game after you’ve collected the rest of the fish is gone. After days of being frustrated with these issues, I’m going to stop checking for the latest patch and just give up.

Long story short: play through it, enjoy the nostalgia, and hope by the time you reach the end game loop that there is even a loop that you’re able to play!

title: A fun return of an old favorite!
text: I was excited to learn that Neko Atsume was releasing a second game after so many years, especially after doing just about everything possible in the original version! I’ve always found the series to be charming and nowadays I check my yard every couple of hours just to see what silly little critters have decided to visit me. Friends and I have made a game of “shaming” the cats that only give 1 silver fish per visit (haha!). I’m enjoying that more goodies (especially ones I remember from the original game) are gradually being introduced, and I’m also admittedly enjoying the subscription feature. The tiers are fairly inexpensive and you can have custom cats dependent on which level tier you have! I have two Mynekos, myself, which are both based off of my cats that passed away earlier this year. It warms my heart to see silly cartoon versions of them playing with toys or napping on beds. I also enjoy the little Helper you get, who helps you set out snacks for cats when you’re too busy to check your phone to refill food dishes. All-in-all, I’m very satisfied with the game and continue to look forward to whatever feature they may share with us next, be they goodies or special kitties!

title: Love, but there’s a Bug
text:
There is a bug in the cat book. It’s not bad, just after I click on a specific cat to look at their “profile” if I click their album, and then “X” to go back to the profile and then “X” to go back to the book, the screen goes blank. Not blank exactly, the background stays and the music keeps playing, and the top right corner options are there, but other than that it’s “blank” there is no way to get back to the yard. I have to leave the app in order to “reset” it, but it happens every time. And that sometimes changes the cats in my yard, so I have to make sure I take any photos I want right away because they might not be there when I reopen the app. I’ve looked around the cat book and other albums, and it only happens in this one spot. Does anyone else have this issue? It’s not a huge deal, I just won’t access their album from the cat book, but if the option is there, it should work.

I do love this app! It’s so fun and the art is cute. I love that you can “collect” cats and get the photos. I had the first version and loved it. I hope I’m gonna love this one just as much!

title: A Classic
text:
This is the perfect game. You don’t need to spend hours (nor should you) perfecting your lawn, anyone can save for the items the really want without NEEDING to purchase the premium. Anyone who can spend the dollar most definitely should, but those who can’t aren’t missing the BEST got critical gameplay. All things perfectly balanced. 
I love visiting partner’s and friends’ yards, though I wish what cats we saw at their yard was the same as their screen. 
I love completing my album of cats as well as purchasing the rotating store of lawn decor. I also loved having my IRL cat in-game when I could spend the dollar on premium. 
As a whole this game is my absolute favorite app. As an animal lover, the dog representation it top-tier. The animation style? Peak. The cat diversity? Ginormous. Hotel? Trivago.
From the broke college student, thank you for the perfect game.

title: Like the original but worse
text: I really love this game, I’ve been playing it on and off ever since I found it however many years ago. I was really excited to see they made a new one, seemingly with new and improved graphics and features. I was disappointed to see that some toys I liked in the previous game aren’t there, and some that you used to automatically have in the og game you have to wait for seasonally. Also, you can’t  transfer silver fish into gold anymore, which is definitely my biggest gripe. I know some people like that you have to fix the toys you buy, but personally I don’t. I don’t like how when you do fix it, sometimes it takes away color or makes it look a lot worse (some toys look fine when repaired, but others don’t). There are so many toys to buy, I don’t want to spend money on the same one I already have. My over all point is that the original game was great, I think they made a couple of great upgrades, but they took away great features that we already had. Why make it worse?

title: Better in some ways worse in others
text: I was really exited when I learned that they Made a second Neko Atsume I loved the first game and spent hours just collecting cats and buying goodies for them. The second game looks better than the first, with more lawns to choose from and expansions, but after a while I began to find little problems with the game. For example the fact that goodies can break disappoints me. Also from what I saw cats no longer give gold fish as a gift and you can only exchange gold fish for silver fish. This makes it nearly impossible to get gold fish without paying real money on the game. Also the visiting system(go out) is kinda flawed. Some things I did enjoy were the appearance of new cats, goodies, and yard expansions. Overall I really enjoyed the game but I would personally rather play the first one. Maybe focus on finding a way to give the players gold fish without making them pay for it. title: Not as good as the first
text: To start, hit-point removed more compared to the first game than they added -.- second, I hate the durability system, you get scammed out of around half the cost of the original item only for the fixed version to still look broken (I've compared directly to the not ruined version of items) really they've only added a couple new pieces of furniture (after removing over fifty percent of what was in the first game) and a couple new animations/specialty cats, while at the same time it takes so much longer to save up for anything (whether it costs gold or silver fish) other all, this really just feels like a stripped back and WiFi-dependent (the cats in your yard literally won't switch out unless you have a good internet connection) version of the first game. title: Improvements on the Original
text: Very good, fun & cute game! If you’ve played the original and are on the fence about downloading this one, I recommend it. There’s a bunch of new cats and new goodies and a new mechanic to visit other people’s yards + register their cats to your catbook as well. Only drawbacks I’ve noticed is that it’s a bit more difficult to get gold fish (+ the gold fish exchange is gone from the shop :/) and it takes a little longer for cats to show up in your yard, though that’s counterbalanced by the food also lasting longer. title: ねこあつめよ永遠なれ
text:
10年ほど前に親のスマホでねこあつめ1をプレイしており、先日ふと思い出してダウンロードしてみました。（新しいバージョンが出ていたので2にしてみました）
絶妙なタッチの猫たちが気ままににわさきに訪れてくれるゆるさはそのままに、色々便利な機能が追加されており、また実家で飼っている猫にそっくりな子がいたことから（くろねこさんです🫶🏻）応援の意味も兼ねて少しの課金も始めました。
ただ、まったくの無課金でもなんの問題もなく遊べます！ここが素晴らしいですよね。課金しないと買えないおもちゃなどもなく、気長に続けていればにぼし（この世界での通貨的なやつです）が溜まるのがいいところだなと思います。最近のアプリはなんでもかんでも課金しろ課金しろ！と、運営を続けていく上には必要な事かもしれないのですがユーザーとしては疲れてしまうことが多かったため、逆に応援したい！という気持ちが強くなりました爆笑爆笑
これは私のおすすめの楽しみ方なのですが、ねこあつめ2には月額160円~からのサブスク的サービスがあるんです！
ログインしていない間もごはんを補充してくれる機能と、自分でカスタマイズした猫（＝マイねこというみたいです）をにわさきにお迎えできる機能があります。
このマイねこ機能が本当にありがたい！！！色や柄なども細かく指定できます。（価格帯によって最大3匹までお迎えできます！）
最近会えていない実家の猫を再現して、実家の猫が好きそうなおもちゃなんかも置いてみました。我ながら、ゲームにここまで本気になったのは初めてです。
アプリを開く度におもちゃで遊んだり、寝ていたりして、めちゃくちゃ癒されます。大好きな猫がいる方はぜひ加入してみてください。おにぎりいっこの値段でプライスレスな癒しが手に入ります。ほんとにほんとにおすすめです！！！
全く負担にならない額の課金でこれほどまでに癒されるのならば、もはやタダ、むしろもっと払わせてほしい。

とても長くなってしまいましたが、本当におすすめのゲームです！！
アプリ内ではユーザー同士の交流（掲示板など）はなく、人と比べたり競ったりせず自分の好きなようにやれるのがいい。
始めてまだ1ヶ月程度ですが、これから先スマホにアプリをひとつしか入れられない！というルールができたら、私はねこあつめ2を最後まで残すでしょう。
運営の皆様、いつもありがとうございます！なんの文句もございません！！！
これからもねこあつめというコンテンツが末永く続くよう、ゲームも、ゲーム以外の展開も、応援しています！！！！！
2026/07/19 追記
新しい機能として追加されたあきんど屋さん（グッズストア的な）の“おだんご”ねこたちが遊ぶ時のポーズがめちゃくちゃ可愛いのでおすすめです！アプデごとに可愛いグッズがどんどん追加されて最高です😭最近だと“プラケース”も実家の猫がよくムギュっとなってたな、、というのが思い出せてめちゃくちゃ良かったです。
アプデがこんなに楽しみなのはねこあつめ２だけです！

title: 無印もやっていました
text:
無印は突然アプリ内のアルバムデータが全部消えてしまってからはショックで細々とやっていました。
先日からこちらの2を始めてようやく庭を拡張できたところです。
体感なのですが、まんぞくさんの来る頻度が前作より上がった気がします。その上で置いていくにぼしが少ないのでかなりにぼし集めに苦戦しました。（運が悪かっただけかもしれないですが……）

とは言え、結局辿り着くのは快適に遊ぶなら課金するという結論です。

どうにも、前作のような感覚で遊べないです。
前述のにぼしの集まりの悪さ、グッズのお手入れでも物によってはにぼしが必要な点、それからこれは感じ方の違いだと思いますが、お手入れ後のグッズの見た目が好きではないです。
「お手入れ」なので新品状態に戻ることはないのはわかるのですが、ねこ達にボロボロのグッズで遊んでもらうのもなんだかなあ……という気持ちになります。かと言って新品を手に入れようとするとまたにぼしが必要になる……

こういう考えが付き纏ってしまうので、同じようなことを気にしてしまう方は無印の方がストレスなく遊べるかもしれないです。
自分はそのうち慣れるだろうと言い聞かせてしばらく遊んでみます。
ねこ達は変わらずモーションもかわいいので癒されます。

title: オフラインで遊ぶと不具合
text:
オフラインで遊ぶとゲームが進行せず,ねこのてサポートも利用できない不具合が起きます。前作がオフラインで遊べるのも魅力だったので対処してくださると嬉しいです。

　•使用機種:iphoneSE2
　•iosバージョン:17.1
　•アプリバージョン:1.0.4
　•不具合の内容:
　オフラインで遊ぶとねこがずっと同じグッズを使用し,ゴハンも減らない。操作は可能。ねこが使用中のグッズを撤去等すると使用中のねこは退場し,お礼にぼしも貰える。ゴハンの補充を手動で行っても補充自体はされるがそこから減らず,ねこも退場しない。
　ねこのてサポートが加入中でも利用できなくなり,にわさき未かくちょうであればサポート分拡張したエリアも表示されなくなる。アプリをオフライン下で中断/終了後再開しても同様の状態が続く。オンライン下で再開すると不具合は解消されるが,ねこのてサポートエリアにせっちしたグッズが全てかたづけられた状態になる。

　前作と違って無課金だと金にぼしが入手しにくくなったのは少し不満ですが,グッズのおていれ,にわさきへおでかけ,ねこのてサポートなど新要素がおもしろいです。不具合はありますが楽しく遊べているのでこれからも応援しています。

title: 100% addicting and truly free to play!
text: I love this game. The animation is not overdone, nor is it physically painful to look at. It’s perfect and sets the scene of a kitten collecting game perfectly. I love the method of ads, the whole cats popping up that have ‘brought you’ ad brochures, I actually have no problem clicking on them. They are not at all in your face and this is why I am actually so eager to tap on ads; they do not pop out at you constantly. While you can use actual money in this game to purchase silver or gold fish, it is definitely possible (and probable) that you could play this game and never need or want to buy either. The app doesn’t harass you trying to get you to spend money, which I really appreicate. Being an English speaker, I would 100% download any game by this company that is translated to English. Kittens rocking themselves while playing with the ball is downright therapeutic, and really calms me as a person with anxiety. If you are triggered by loud or sudden noises, you will find none here. Every toy is adorable and actually realistically things that kittens play with (boxes, paper bags, balls, yarn, etc.) The only thing about this game that I do not enjoy is the fact that you can only expand your yard once. I would love to be able to display many/all of my goodies at once! I will continue to play this game and hope that it only improves, and that it is not consumed by greed and thus the quality goes down. Thanks for making such an amazing game and sharing it with the world!

Is there any way I can get my money back, or maybe get the goldfish I bought? I hope my problem could be solved.

Before I go to bed each night, I always check on my cats! This game is incredible! I just wish the money problem could be fixed. title: Neko Atsume is Literally the best game ever.
text: I absolutely adore this game. The designs are simple yet so cute and looking at these adorable kitties always makes my day so much better. The fact that you have to leave the app for the cats to come is so smart, it forces you to spend less time on your phone to advance in the game rather than spending most of the gameplay within the app. But I do have one problem with it, you are limited to only one yard expansion for the entire game, and at times it can be difficult to determine with goodies to place mostly because of the lack of space. It would be nice to see a set of separate yard expansions for the rest of the house. Along with other variations of the house expansion for each remodel setup. I would also recommend a part of the game being where you can interact with the cats when visiting your yard, and depending on how well you treat the visiting cats, the better or worse gifts they give. And when looking in the catbook, along with the feature of a cat’s favorite goodies it would also feature how to interact with that certain cat. Those are the only points I’ll bring up relating to advice, but I still love this game with all my heart and I always will enjoy this game and the cats in it.

title: One of my favorite games, would recommend
text: To everyone reading this, as the title said, this is one of my favorite games to play. I have played on multiple different devices and I have enjoyed collecting furniture to decorate the yard and porch, finding cute new kitties, and taking cute pictures. I also love finding the rare cats. It is especially enjoyable because cats come pretty quickly, it doesn’t take too much commitment to play, and it keeps me playing for a while before I start to get bored after a few weeks or months. The art is adorable as well. I would recommend this game to anyone looking to play a cute, fun, and non time consuming game. I would appreciate a few updates such as maybe adding more rooms and upgrades of space to add more items, new fun items, and a few new cats to keep me and other players playing longer, as I can not say that there has been an update for around the three or four years I have played, and I take breaks every once in a while before coming back. No complaints, just a suggestion to keep me interested and hooked on the game. This is an amazing game so if you see this review you should definitely give it a try.

title: Underrated
text: I don’t think people understand that this game isn’t suppose to be so interactive and storytelling as others are. The game is great, don’t get me wrong, but it’s more of a “Tomagochi” (if I spelled that right). You watch your Tsuki develop and form new relationships, and you can decide on some fun or cute furniture options. You can fish to kill some time, but for the most part, this game’s pleasant experience is in the relaxing nature of closing your game, and coming back to find Tsuki doing something new with the many items he can obtain, or purchase. The microtransactions are almost non existent. I haven’t purchased a thing, and am super satisfied with my gameplay. This wasn’t meant to be a clingy game, forcing you to constantly observe every action and try to strategize.. It’s made for people with a little less time on their hands. I open my game about 3-5 times a day, to collect my carrots, let an ad or two play (for carrots- and without it being so excessive), and simply close it and get on with my day. Sometimes I’ll stumble upon fun activities my Tsuki is up to, such as using that bubblegum I picked up or playing with the jump robe I got him. It’s one of the only games (if not the ONLY game), I’ve had that allows me to relax and not focus on competitive status or strategic focus. And for those complaining that they don’t like the “mean” comments of the NPCs, you can turn it off in settings.. However I love this feature, it just feels more interactive when constantly talking to an NPC gets them annoyed lol. If you want a 100% friendly experience, turn it off. I still find myself enjoying this hidden gem everyday, and cannot wait for future updates to see where, or how far, this game goes.

title: Wonderful, Cute Lovable Characters
text:
Tabikaeru has a gorgeous style, and is another nice Hit-Point game where you don’t have to actively play, but rather check in periodically over a long time. The characters are adorable and the frog is very charming on his adventures. Ads are not forced upon you, the only ads you will ever see are brief ads which you can watch now and then in return for a lottery ticket. Everything can be gradually achieved without purchases, and if you do want to support the developers I’d suggest just buying some extra clovers to get the bell lucky charm sooner. 
The game is completely in Japanese. The gameplay is simple enough to figure out and enjoy on your own, and if you get stuck you can search online for one of multiple walkthroughs for english speaking players. Still, I hope for an eventual translation because I’d love to read all the little details like item descriptions and whatnot. 
If you enjoyed Neko Atsume, you will love this game. It is especially nice to have it at along with friends, so you can clarify things or give tips and tricks as you figure out the game. It is especially fun to show off the latest postcard your frog sent, and see what others got. 
The only thing I wish were different about the game is that there was not 9 page limit to postcards, or at least that you could buy more pages like in Neko Atsume photo albums. I absolutely hate deleting any adorable pictures my frog sent me, but I must if want room for all new ones. It took me a while to reach this limit, but ever since I have I keep having to go back and delete more postcards to make room. That is literally my only issue with this game though, overall it is wonderful and I absolutely recommend it.

title: A game to love and care for
text: Tabikaeru allows you to raise a froggy of your own—you purchase food and other travel items for your frog and watch it head off for travel and adventure. In the meantime, you wait (patiently) at home, collecting 3-leaves clovers (the currency in this gams) and hoping to receive some postcards from your frog’s travels. Eventually, (though the time is random) your frog comes home and brings back souvenirs! Then, you simply wait until they embark on their next journey. Despite its simplicity and (lack) of gameplay features, Tabikaeru is an incredibly addictive game that leaves you obsessed with your tiny frog friend/pet/child. I just open the app once in a while to collect clovers and check if my frog is back yet/left on another trip. Because of the minimal features you won’t be stuck in this game for more than 10min at a time. But it’s easy to understand and keep up, best if you are busy and can’t dedicate to a more complex game! Also it’s just fun unlocking new places and receiving cute postcards of your frog’s adventures ;w;

title: Beautiful game
text:
The art style is my favourite part of this game. I love Neko Atsume and Spoon Pets, but this shows you can still have an adorable, addictive game be appealing through a softer, sweeter look. The style makes me homesick for my years spent in Japan - Tabikaeru really embodies the peaceful, slower pace of the neighbourhoods and countryside of such a lovely country. The obvious care in the style of food, the half organized half haphazard little house, the memento pictures; everything is perfect.  
  
Admittedly while I’m more than comfortable using Google Translate in order to play, I’m afraid that it’s fairly obvious that a lot of the warm, cozy meaning is lost in translation. The game makes up for much of this through the art, but I’m honestly looking forward to the English version and hope they’ll still be able to convey the relaxed happy adventurer feeling in the end.

title: Perfection
text: This game is one of the most peaceful and beautiful games I have ever played (and I have played a lot of games), and may even be my favorite game ever. Yes, there are a few ads, but that is how the game makes money and with it being as good as it is when it’s FREE, I can surely deal with them. Plus, unlike most free mobile games, the ads are not constant and do not make you want to throw your phone across the room. I do not understand why this game isn’t that popular, as it is one of the most relaxing games ever. It also isn’t too easy like most relaxing games, so you do not get sick of it so easily. There are so many goals you can try to reach for, like collecting all the fish and objects, exploring all the different worlds, buying the best boat and character, or maxing out all of your tools. There are even events everyday with a different world per event. Finally, this game is by far the most relaxing game I played. The music is lovely, the sounds are peaceful, and casting your fishing rod and watching it sink down really eases you. If I had to describe this game in one word, that word would be perfection. Love it. Keep up the amazing work creators! And to all the people debating on whether or not to get it... get it! You won’t regret it!

The fish reset every so often and the only way to catch the big ones is by getting the little ones out of the way or by purchasing over priced bait that only catches larger fish. Eventually, you realize that the fish respawn and are places in the way you want to go due to them spawning in too frequently and whenever an ad comes up. 

Could be a near 5 star game but this ruins it for all players.

title: Unless you love ads, don’t play this game
text: Lot more stressful then you think. This free game is just not worth it. Starting off is rough because you have to upgrade your bait in order to catch bigger fish. In order to “level up” your bait you have to use smaller fish to use as bait. Once upgraded you can catch bigger fish only to find out your rod isn’t high enough level. Sometimes a smaller fish you didn’t want will get caught and your bait that you worked to upgrade is now gone. Good thing you can spend in-game currency to buy lures to avoid the smaller fish but if you try to catch too big of a fish that bait and lure is now wasted. It’s also really difficult to earn in-game currency. You only get money for selling the fish but you can’t sell the fish if you use it as bait, so essentially it becomes a cycle of trying to get better bait to catch bigger fish but only catch the small ones to use as bait again. The only real way to earn in-game currency is by watching ads.

It’s also extremely difficult to catch anything other than one and two start fish. One star fish are far too common, and will always snag the bait before anything else gets a chance to get it. You can buy things to equip, but you’re wasting thousands of gold on something that’s a one time use, and not even guaranteed to work. I enjoyed playing the game at first, but now that I’ve made more progress, it is just far too difficult to obtain anything at all, and I just feel like deleting it. There is only one thing that comes easy in this game; ads.

text: This game is great for people who like calming, simple games, that are straight to the point. The whole objective of the game is to catch fish, upgrade your boat, and get to new locations. The new locations don’t give you new challenges or anything, they just give you new fish to catch. And when you get some of those tool upgrades, it’s so nice to see how much more efficient your boat gets. If this game were to be described in one word, it would be Satisfying. title: It’s great but please stop the freezing problem
text: I think this game is a blast and I’ve really enjoyed playing it along with enjoying myself during the events. This game is really fleshed out with a lot to do and a fun progression system and a lot of unlockables. However, this game also needs some improvements. For anyone who is just starting out, be warned there are ads. They weren’t really apparent but one day I was playing and all of a sudden anytime I opened a package, or a gem chest, I was forced to watch an ad. It had never happened before but it became very frustrating very fast so I gave up and begrudgingly paid for no ads. The only current prominent problem I’ve been running into since is constant freezing when I start up the game, it hasn’t been much of an issue besides being a minor inconvenience to close out the app and then reopen it. However I’ve recently come to realize that it has been robbing me of certain achievement rewards for the event due to freezing right after I claimed them, which has left me quite disheartened as there’s no way to reclaim those lost rewards. I write this review because I wish for the team behind the game to please fix this issue, as I wish to continue playing this game yet these freezing issues are making me feel less and less motivated to play knowing that all my effort might again end in vain.

title: Too many ads
text:
Many apps have a ad cool down, where once I’ve watched an ad willingly to get a reward, the normal actions that trigger ads won’t trigger. Idle world, for example, has this feature. This game… does not. If I watch an ad to double my reward on a crate, when the ad ends  and I can hit claim, another ad plays. These ads are the type where “30 seconds maximum” is very loose, where after the 30 seconds, another 15 second clip plays, then you have to find the tiny x button while the information for the ad keeps popping up. And then there’s another one. These triggered ads don’t have a small timer before you can x out alike most unwanted ads; you have to watch the entire 45+ seconds to claim your reward. The crates come pretty frequently, too, so this happens many, many times. Oh, and if you exit out of the app and come back in to trick the system into thinking you’ve already watched the ad, at any point? You get no reward and all the crates you’ve stacked up have $0 in them now. And airplane mode doesn’t work. It’s so simple to just disable the ad that pops up when I hut claim immediately after I’ve already watched an entire ad.

The game layout is great. The simple art is lovely. The mechanics are simple and easy to understand. Even the pacing of the game makes sense. Truly, a 5 star game. But the ads annoy me so, so much that I’m on the verge of deleting the game altogether.

title: Incredibly charming and lots of fun!
text:
This game simply consumed my free time in the past few days. It’s so charming, pretty and fun! I just reached the end and I can’t help but feel sad about it.

The story is very sweet and I liked how I got to gradually form deeper friendships with each character. My only issues would be that some of the dialogue felt a bit excessive(the whole Johnny arc felt very, very tiring and stretched out) and the rocket arc was way too quick. I had barely started playing, and suddenly there’s a rocket and all the characters(who I just met) are treating me like a super close friend? These issues are minor, though, and are mainly a matter of refining the narrative. I still enjoyed the story regardless.

The fishing mechanics are very simple, and I must say I really liked how fast the worms fill back up. I always groan at games that set an energy timer because they are excruciatingly slow, obviously to encourage you to spent real money on it. With this game, however, it only takes 90 seconds for each worm to refill, and that was such a pleasant surprise. Within 20 minutes or so the worm bucket is full. The ads also were never intrusive in the gameplay, and I didn’t mind at all using ads to refill the worm bucket. Unlike most games, there’s no limit to how many times you can watch ads to do that, and it really made fishing more fun.

With all this, It feels like the dev team really cared about the product they made and put a lot of passion into it. There were no pay to win mechanics and no push for micro transactions at all. I must say, you guys really impressed me.

title: Overall: 4.25/5 (Excellent)
text:
First off, let me tell you how much I LOVE Odencat. They are my personal favorite mobile game developers, and their games are always amazing, I highly recommend all of their games. 

On to the review…. 

Fishing Paradiso is a fishing/story game set in the afterlife. The main premise is doing a fishing minigame in different areas, catching and selling different fish. Later you unlock Side Quests, where you can catch a certain amount of a fish to give to an NPC.

Pros: Characters are cohesive, fun, and memorable. There are several fun interactions in between them, and the cutscenes are adorable. The ads are few and far between, and are only in exchange for a reward. The art style is Undertale-esque, and the backgrounds are beautiful. The cutscenes are also amazing. After the main game, there is so much more to do. Tons of replayability. 

Cons: although I love this game, it is far from perfect. The gameplay is repetitive and somewhat unintuitive. The main game is pretty short, it took me around 4 hours to beat it on and off. The game feels, although beautiful, very shallow. The characters are great, but there is no real message that can see. If I did miss a message/theme, feel free to let me know.

Characters: 4.5/5 (Excellent)
Story: 3.5/5 (Good)
Gameplay: 2.5/5 (Fair)
Graphics: 5/5 (Perfect)
Atmosphere/music: 5/5 (Perfect)

title: とりあえずEDまで！楽しい！
text:
レビューを見るとかなり前のゲームのようですので伝わるか分かりませんが....！

なんか釣りゲームないかなぁと探していたら出会ったゲームで、操作はシンプルながらストーリーが重すぎず、スッキリとした内容で個人的に好きな内容でした！まだED以降はこれからですが楽しくプレイできそうです。

広告がーというのを散見しましたが、私はダウンロードが終わってからノンストップでプレイし、エサ引換券を3枚使って無くなったところで課金させていただいた形というのもあって、強制広告を見た記憶がなく、とても快適にプレイできました。値段も良心的、スポンサー文に関しても「あ、いい開発者さんなのかな」と思えるような文の書き方で好感が持てました。

現在はエサ無限と強制広告の解除、シルバースポンサーで楽しませてもらってますっ

個人的にED直前のステージのbgmがとても好きです(スポンサー権限で固定するくらいすきです)

また最後に軽くですが、こんなのはどうでしょう？という提案だけさせていただきたいと思います

提案1 釣った魚の最高ランクを図鑑一覧で見れるようにする
ED到達時点では、釣った魚の大きさ、釣った数などはタップすれば見れますが、ランクはわからない+一覧でSというバッジがずらっと並んでいるとやり込みがいがあるかなと思いました。

提案2 友人以来のアイコン表示条件
釣り画面で友人依頼があるときにでてくるえいこんですが、基本的には「一回ソラホを開かないと表示されない」「新しい友人が増えて且つその友人からの依頼があるとき」「ストーリーが進んだ時」がアイコン表示される条件と思ってるのですが裏を返すと「依頼を達成した後に新しい依頼がすぐ発生した時」「依頼発生条件を魚を初めて釣った時」にはアイコンが出ないということになり、個人的に「あ、依頼あるじゃん！！」となることもありました。それ以降はこまめにチェックするようにしたのでいいのですが、せっかくのアイコンですので、その辺りにも対応できると親切かなと思いました

提案3 HITする魚の優先順位
少しエゴにはなってしまうのですが、メインストーリーの魚、サブミッションの魚、特にその時には関係のない魚、これらの魚たちがHITする優先度を変えてあげるといいかなとも思いました。
なかなか釣り上げるのに時間がかかる魚とかだと、「違うお前じゃない！」ってなるような魚がかかり、その間に欲しかった魚が逃げてシュンとなるケースがちょこちょこあったので...

提案4 逃すボタンの追加
提案3とも被ってくるのですが、現在のシステム上、HITした魚をすぐにリリースする方法がありません。放置でもそこそこかかるなぁという印象でした。釣るにしてもやたら耐えてくる個体引いちゃうと格下でもかなり時間かかってしまうことも多かったので💦ですので、「こいつはいらない！」って思った子がかかってしまった際には、逃すボタンがあってもいいのかなと思いました。
※逃すボタンを押して逃すということはミスじゃない限りいらないはずなので、HIT魚は釣ったと同じ扱いで画面には残らないって感じいいと思います

以上です！あれこれやんややんやと言ってしまいましたがとてもいいゲームだと思います、これからも楽しんでプレイしていきます！

title: あまり不満とかはありません
text:

くまレスの後日談ときいてDLし、ラストまでいきました。
キャラの個性が強くて良かったですし、私はRPGとか物語ゲーしかしないので釣りゲーか…とは思いましたが、操作が簡単なのと図鑑のお魚の説明が好きでコンプ目指してハマってしまいました。

・少しモヤッとしたのが、主人公の素性がイマイチよくわからないことですね。
プレイヤーと一番触れ合うことの多い主人公が謎に包まれていると、不信感とまではいかないけどなんだか気持ち良くはなかったですね…

title: 昔ながらのドット絵ゲーム、のんびりできる
text:
クマレスのキャラが出てくる
ということでプレイ。
懐かしのドット絵とBGMに癒されます。

基本的に
「釣りをする」「依頼を達成」
「ストーリーが進む」の繰り返し。
コレクション要素として
「魚の図鑑を埋めていく」
「家具の収集、設置」
「キャラクターの友好度をあげる」
こともでき、クリアするために
ガツガツゲームをするというよりのんびり気ままにプレイするのがおすすめです。

グラフィックの綺麗なゲームでも、
ストーリーがめちゃくちゃ作り込まれたRPGでもないですが、作り手の愛が伝わってくる
ゲーム。シリーズ全て惹きこまれます。
無料提供するには限度があると思うので、
多少の広告には寛容な気持ちで目を瞑りたいですね。

プレイ中に、依頼の魚を釣っても
たまにカウントされない事があります。
それだけ少し気になりましたが、
のんびりプレイすることにします。
素敵な作品に感謝です。

title: I love it even more than the original! :)
text: I started playing the original Pocket Camp game in 2022, and I’ve been playing it until it was discontinued. I loved the original one- it was like the mainstream Animal Crossing games, but on your phone. The only downside with that one is that some cool features such as picking a camp caretaker and picking extra fortune cookies was something you had to pay for monthly. Well, in this new version, all of the monthly subscriptions are included in the game! I like this game even more than the original because there is so much more to do! The special currency (it was leaf tickets, now it’s leaf tokens) is now much easier to get compared to the original, so you can buy more things. For example, I always had about 20 leaf tickets at a time, but now I have 400 leaf tokens! Some things I’ve always wanted to do in the original was change my camp theme, have a camp caretaker, and get more special furniture without having to save up for months. I can do that now and it makes me so happy! Overall, I really really love this game and I love the new features! I would recommend it to anyone who loves cozy, relaxing games where you can decorate and talk with animal friends! It is definitely worth the money! Thank you for taking the time to read this :) ✨

I’m not sure if you can invite IRL players. but there’s definitely these animal characters in the game you can invite and have friends over. You can also get a fortune cookie and collect furniture. Going to stop there. There’s way more but I want you to discover it. Just know this game definitely is a 10 out of 10. I’m not being modest.

title: Every Game Should Be Like This
text: I was quite literally lamenting over the quiet death of complete paid games, every single game either has in app purchases or you just can’t play without being bombarded with ads. AS SOON AS I SAID THIS Pocket Camp announced that they were releasing a complete, paid app. Bravo, first off, what an amazing game from the very start. I’m so glad you guys made this change and I’m excited to see what comes next. Leaf tokens are so much better than tickets, and they make the game so much more accessible for people who just wanna play a game without throwing money at it. If I could change a few things, it would be this; I’ve always wished there were more actual perks to leveling up friendships beyond 15. Like the ability to maybe craft more special request furniture, maybe in variations? Also, maybe you guys could add the ability to customize and design in the spaces on the islands where other players and their campers used to be? Regardless, this is a perfect game and other mobile games should take note. This is the only mobile game I really play. I recommend it to everyone I know, ESPECIALLY now that it’s a one time purchase! Thank you Nintendo!!!

title: Not quite worth it :(
text: When I heard there was a new pocket camp game coming out I was both a little upset and excited. For a game that was entirely free before i expected there to be a lot more added for it being $10 now. there is a new location but it’s completely useless all that you go there for is to ask for quarry help and watch concerts ie kk slider. There’s absolutely no interaction with friends which makes all the “new perks” of making journal content purchasable irrelevant. you can’t gift friends or literally anything. My favorite thing about the new game is the replacement currency of whatever the cash was called. Another thing I actually like is the fact that you can upload clothes from new horizons into your pocket camp game, that’s honestly my favorite feature. Everything’s a little cheaper and hopefully they stay attainable. there’s not enough added to the game though it’s pretty much exactly the same except different in ways that are not likable to anyone who’s been playing this game for at least a year. to deactivate a game that’s been around for 7 years that has a ginormous platform of daily players and then charge them $10 for the same game other than ONE new feature and reused subscription data (now free because we paid $10) None of the subscriptions were good enough to continuously do month after month so yeah forcing people to buy this game ig was the only way you were gonna use that subscription content. its just messed up and i’m very sad to say that i’m severely disappointed because i loveddddd this game.

title: Does not save
text: While I initially appreciated that Nintendo was giving its players the opportunity to continue playing this game after they decided to cease supporting it, I now regret paying $10 for it (there was a discounted price offered to players when they first transitioned to Complete). I’m not sure why they kept the Friends feature when there are no updates to my Friends’ cards and they seem forever frozen in Halloween / Christmas attire when the original game ended.  I only realized my Friends’ cards weren’t being updated because the only in-game friend that I know irl was surprised to see her avatar and level didn’t reflect her recent changes.  This actually makes looking at my Friends’ cards pretty depressing as it’s a constant reminder that the game is actually dead and this is just a prolonged goodbye as I can’t bring myself to take it off life support.  But the worst part that makes me regret purchasing this is the fact that it no longer saves any changes to your account to the cloud so that you can redownload your most recent data to other devices.  I recently purchased a new device and downloaded Complete only to discover that it didn’t save any of the updates I made over the past 6 months.  I realize that Nintendo is trying to phase out Animal Crossing Pocket, but I don’t understand why it’s so difficult on their part to allow us to backup our data.  Now I wish I had just cut my ties to this game when they announced they were ending it rather than continue this depressing goodbye.

title: Almost perfect but lacking for the price
text: This game is definitely better and less money crazed than the previous game but still deleting everyone’s progress and reuploading the game and forcing the free to play players to pay for it is still wrong. And the game is still lacking for the 20$ price tag. The graphics could have been improved and there are many other flaws that need fixed. Like materials. It is almost impossible to keep materials like wood, cloth, and etc stocked up so it is impossible to craft items. The market used to be a good way to get these and fruit that doesn’t grow on your island, but now it has been removed from the game. Also we need to change the fortune cookie system because it takes way to long for them to refresh the stock. Like change them out every day instead of having them on there for days to a week. I don’t care about these holiday items and it annoys me that there is no way to get furniture I want to try to get without having to use a seasonal ticket. Just make the cookies refresh daily. But other than these things the game is flawless. So I would still say it was worth the money since it is way easier to afford everything that would have taken thousands of leaf currency to get in the previous title.

title: great game, but there are bugs
text:
I have had the free one for a long time so when i saw this was coming out, i was excited and i like a lot of the new features. everything's not hidden behind a pay wall, leaf tickets are easier to get, and so on. but there a bug i am experiencing where i can click on all my animals, except the one thats my helper!! its been going on for a few days, sometimes it lets me but it hasn’t in awhile, i cant even talk to my helper if i wanted to because it just pulls up the left striped loading screen but it never loads. i cant click on him, i cant click on the book itself, it will not load either way so my helper hasn’t been able to do what he is meant to do because i cannot gather his collected items. i think this should be looked at! its the only issue i keep encountering, everything else is great! the characters, clothing and furniture, events! i definitely recommend this game, i find it to be funner than new horizons, but i hope they fix this issue.

edit: with events, you can usually give a gift to your favorite animal. my favorite animal is also my campsite helper, i have not been able to interact or change my campsite helper which is very frustrating, i hope this gets looked at soon!

title: Love it!!
text: Animal Crossing Pocket Camp is everything you could want and more, here’s why… first off, regular animal crossing, the one you’d get on a console, well you’d have to have one to play it. With this, all you need is an iPad or a phone, which makes it overall way more accessible. Secondly, it’s such a relaxing gameplay experience, and there is SO much you can do, as you might have read in the description. You can dress your character, you can make friends with the animals, you can gather fruit and elements of nature, you can design your cabin and your campsite, buy, sell and collect loads of cute furniture. One of the great things about Animal Crossing is just that it’s relaxing and free. Like say in, some games there is a goal or objective, but in this game you’re free to just hang out and design things, like your outfit or your camper van. You can make friends with animals, give them snacks, and SOO much more, that if I were to list everything it would be a lot. So yeah, I would highly suggest this if you’re looking for a cute and cozy relaxing game with animals. Disclaimer: it may be a little complicated at first, but I assure you it gets easier as you play it more.

title: 運営さん最高にありがたい🥹
text:
ポケ森のサービス終了を聞いた時には長年続けていた事もあり喪失感さえ覚えましたが、有料版のアプリをリリースし、今までのデータを残して遊べるようにしてくれたのは本当にありがたいです！
前作でリーフチケットが必要な家具・服・フォーチュンクッキー等の値段が大体10分の1の価格になっていたのでリーフストーンの入手機会は少ないのかな？と初めは残念に感じていましたが、今シーズンのイベント報酬で大量に（800か900個くらい？）入手できる事が判明したので今までよりも限定家具・服・クッキーが格段に買いやすくなったのが本当に嬉しいです🫶実際に今まで買えなかった服を沢山買ってクッキーも何十個か食べました！🥠キャンプ場のどうぶつ達に惜しみなく限定服やクッキー服を着せてあげることが出来て大満足です🥳
新しい要素のコンプリートチケットもコンプリートカタログから限定家具や服がどれでも1枚で交換できるようなので、前作ポケ森で手が届かなかった定価の高い家具を交換するのに1枚使いました！貨物船ではどうぶつの地図が入手できる島に新たにリーフストーンやコンプリートチケットの報酬が追加されていたので現在フル稼働で集め中です🛳️💭
今までは有料版機能だったどうぶつの連れ歩きやキャンプ場、コテージ、コーデの保存などが初めから使えるのも最高です！✨好きなどうぶつとお揃いコーデで歩けるので毎日着替えて他のフィールドに出歩くのが楽しみです😚︎‪
フレンドとの機能（イベントのおすそわけ、バザー、キャンプ場等への訪問）などが使えなくなったのは少々寂しいですが、そもそもサービス終了するアプリを内容をそのまま、しかも新イベントや復刻イベントが続く新しいアプリとして提供してくれた事が本当に嬉しかったです。有料版アプリの情報を聞いた時はデータの引き継ぎができるデータ保管庫的なアプリだとばかり思っていたので新情報が出た時にはワクワクが止まりませんでした。しかも1日早くリリースされて驚きました😳
お陰様でこれからもポケ森を遊ぶ事ができます。本当にありがとうございました！！✨🥰

title: 面白い！！
text:
すっげー面白いです、まだ新しいアイテムやクッキーが出てますし、980円となっていますがゲーム内は課金要素が撤廃されアイテム収集がとても捗ります。買い切り版が出てすぐやり始めた頃はクッキーの値段に驚きを隠せなかったです…
980円以上の価値はありにあると思います、住民たちも可愛く色んな着せ替えも出来ますし入れ替えがいつでも出来て今まではあまり気にならなかった子が意外と気に入ったりして従来のメインな方のどう森シリーズよりも色んな子達を沢山愛でることが出来る(個人的見解)のが中々楽しいです。
ただ復刻したイベント家具などを作る際にナチュラルのもとなどどうしても使う性格のもとが多い割に入手経路が鉱山の報酬かたまに風船を割ったら運が良ければ出るフータの地図や対応した住民の好感度、キャンプにいる対応した住民からのプレゼントくらいしかなく地図以外はどれもあまり集まらないようなものばかりなのがちょっと残念です…
あとフレンド機能も中身は居ないのに毎回鉱山の手伝いの時に渋ったり悩んだりする時間は要るんだろうかと毎回思っちゃったりします…断られた人の所にまた聞き直すのもなんかイヤで、神経質なだけなんだと思いますがなんか時間の無駄だなあと思ってしまいます…
基本的にプラスの部分が沢山あるので全然こんなの気にするべきじゃないと思うんですがね…！ほんとに面白いゲームです、サービス終了前のポケ森をやってなかった人でも是非ともやって欲しい！過去のアイテムを選べるチケットがあったり毎回1ヶ月ごとにイベントや過去のアイテム、クッキーなどが沢山復刻してくれるので月替わりの時は毎回ワクワクします！

title: Déception
text:
J’ai joué à la version gratuite de pocket camp de nombreuses années et j’avais toujours le même plaisir à ouvrir l’application et découvrir les nouveautés proposées chaque mois. 
À l’annonce de la fermeture définitive de la version gratuite et d’une nouvelle version payante j’étais triste mais curieuse. 
Quelle déception… j’avais hâte de découvrir ce qui nous attendait, un nouveau jeu ? De nouvelles aventures ? De nouvelles options ? 
Presque pas ! A peine ! Un nouveau terrain avec keke et ses amis mais sinon que des déceptions. 
- plus de marché, on ne peut plus acheter ni vendre des produits et voir la progression de nos amis
-recyclage des anciens items aussi bien les items du mois à collecter que les objets à gagner au concours de pêche, chasse aux gyroides. 
-On ne peut pas partager ses insectes avec les autres joueurs. 
-pas de nouveaux personnages. 

En faite on achète un jeu moins bien que ça version gratuite. Du jamais vu. On dirait que Nintendo ne supportait plus d’avoir une équipe pour ce jeu et de le maintenir alors ils ont décidé de faire payer le jeu, de ne plus y toucher de laisser le jeu tel quel. Ils ne veulent même pas que les joueurs puis jouer ensemble tout est au minimum !! 
Déçue de Nintendo et leur politique. Les décisions prises sont très clairs; se faire de l’argent en faisant le moins possible de travail et de maintenance. Reflet d’une triste réalité qui rejoint animal crossing new horizons dans la déception et le manque de respect pour les joueurs. 

Je ne recommande pas le jeu.

title: 『もと』が全然足りない
text:
ポケ森の頃最初3年は熱心に遊び、その後辞めてしまっていてコンプリートで戻ってきました。

直近4年分のイベントとクッキーが初見なので、全部かわいくてあれも欲しいこれも欲しいと作りまくってたらあっという間に『もと』がすっからかんになりました。

ナチュラル・カントリー・オールドなどのもとはキャンプ場にその属性の子にいて貰えばたまに3〜9個程度くれますが、復刻のもとととピカピカのもとはまじで全然手に入らないのにクラフトの度に絶対に使わなきゃいけなくて、だんだん「このアイテムのために3個も使うの？じゃあいいや」と荒んだ気持ちになってきました。

たまーーに鉱山に来ても貰えるのはたったの4個？？1個？？？？うそでしょ？って声に出ました。ゲームバランスおかしいです。めちゃくちゃ使うものなんだからハニワのように大量に出してほしい。(最低でも20とか)

家具は今作らないと次いつ作れるのかわからないのに材料足りなくて作れない、じゃあリーフストーンってなるとリーフストーンでしか買えないものがどんどん買えなくなって悪循環でしかありません。楽しくゲームさせてください。

鉱山断られる流れも頻度高すぎてイライラするので減らして欲しいです。

ナチュラルのもと なども家具優先に使い続けているのでたまらない上、地図でキャラクターを呼び出す時に使う量が多すぎてコンプリート始めてからまだ誰も呼び出せてません。100枚くらい溜まってます。

鉱山に求めてる『もと』がやっときた！と思って行っても数個しか貰えなくて時間の無駄だったな…って毎回思います。

ともだちのもとも今はいっぱいあるけどコンプリートに稼ぐ方法ってあるんでしょうか。

『もと』の供給量、お願いですから改善してください。

title: A great game has become even greater!!!
text:
I finally downloaded this game later this month and have been obsessed with it! Here are the changes that I like:
1. I love the Leaf Tokens!!! They are so much easier to get, not only through the monthly bell exchange but you can also get them from the seasonal events, or missions, Gullivers ship, homeroom classes and by leveling up!!! I have already bought so much stuff, for my character plus i have dressed up my guests in both my campsite and cabin in full on christmas outfits, change my campsite background and remodelled it, as well as my cabin’s first and second floor 😂 it is so much fun!!!

Now the things that need a bit of improvement:

2. I wish there was a way to share our bugs with someone. I know the online function is gone now, but maybe we can just exchange them somewhere else for friend dust? 

Other than that i love the game so muchhhh!!! 😍

title: ある程度良心的には感じる
text:
従来ポケ森は配信日に開始、推しどうぶつの実装が比較的遅かった為に、復帰と休止を繰り返しマイペースにプレイしていた者です。
予約はしなかったものの、追加課金不要とのことで購入。
日数を経ればアイテム等も従来のポケ森より集めやすいのでは？という体感。
既に旧リフチケ限定衣装やキャンプ場装飾などもいくつも購入しており、楽しませていただいております。
連れ歩き(アシスタント)機能が常に利用可能で推しどうぶつと一緒に活動できるのはとても嬉しいです。
また、クラフト時間もリーフストーンで恒常的に短縮出来る点も良いかと感じました。
しかし買い切り版なのにサカナ・ムシ・果物などの持ち物欄の上限があるのが大変不便です。アシスタント機能が常備されているため頻繁に上限を超えたので受け取れませんとなりストレスです。上限の撤廃か、せめて倍近くに上限を上げていただきたいです。
くちぶえ峠でマイキャンパーカードを所持している他ユーザーのアシスタントのシール(スケジュール帳に利用可)を確率入手できますが、個人的には自分のアシスタントのシールの方が欲しかったりします……いずれシールストアで販売されたりするのでしょうか…？

また、せっかく買い切りアプリなのですから、ウィジェット機能で表示させれる動物は選択できるようにして頂けたら嬉しいなと個人的に思います。

早期購入価格で購入した者ですが、現行価格でダウンロードを推奨出来るかと言うとなんとも言えません。

title: 楽しいけれど、もう一歩進化して欲しい🥺
text:
プレイを初めて3日目、現在キャンパーレベル80です。シリーズファンとして、スマホで遊べる買い切り版という点に魅力を感じて始めました。
👍 良かった点
• 快適な操作性: 移動や売買など、面倒な作業を効率的にスキップできる。
• 魅力的な世界観: 可愛いどうぶつたちに癒される。キャンプ場で自由に過ごす姿を見るのが楽しい。
• 豊富なカスタマイズ: インテリアや洋服の種類が豊富で、レイアウトを考えるのが楽しい。
• 買い切りなので追加課金の心配がない。
🔺改善してほしい点
• フレンド通信要素の欠如: 他プレイヤーとの交流がないため、モチベーションが続きにくい。
• 単調なゲーム性: レベルが上がってもイベント以外の遊び方に変化がなく、同じ作業の繰り返しで飽きやすい。
• やり込み要素の不足:
• キャンパー招待数100人達成など、達成時の特別なご褒美や機能がない。
• 仲良し度の高いどうぶつとの会話や遊び要素が少ない。
• 物足りない施設: こもれび広場の規模や品揃えが少なく、シリーズ作品のような施設が成長する要素がほしい。
• 探索・採取の不足:
• 行ける島やエリアが狭く、探索要素が少ない。
• 虫や魚の種類が少なく、レア生物の出現も少なく、採取の達成感がない。それと海に潜れたら嬉しい。
• イベントの難易度: イベントが簡単すぎて、もう少し挑戦性がほしい。
結論
世界観、デザイン、基礎システムは素晴らしいだけに、「変化や発展が少ない」ことが飽きやすさに繋がっていると感じます。
やり込み要素や成長要素が増えれば、もっと長く遊びたいと思える作品です。シリーズファンとして、今後のより良いアップデートに期待しています。応援しています。

title: ポケ森コンプは必要です🥲
text:
ポケ森は毎日毎日欠かさずプレイしていて、こんだけ楽しいアプリはないと思うほどポケ森ファンな私は、近日サービス終了と聞いた瞬間は泣きそうになりました。毎日のように遊んでいたのに「急に遊べなくなるとか考えられない!!」と叫んだりしていました。ですが、ポケ森コンプリートが新しく出ると聞き、驚きました😳すぐさまようつべに飛び動画を見たんです！
ポケ森コンプを遊ぶ前は、
「結構変わってるんだろうな、、」とはっきり言うとそんなに期待はしていませんでした💦ですが実際にプレイしてみたらなんと‼️‼️ちょーちょーちょー神ゲーだったんです🥹🥹
個人的に神だなと思ったところを以下に書きます💦

ポケ森では服や家具を購入する際にはリーフチケットが多く必要だったのですが、コンプリートでリーフストーンに変わってから、服や家具を買うにもそんなにリーフストーンを使わない‼️しかもリーフストーンが手に入りやすい🥹

ポケ森には3つのコースがあって、どれも課金をしないと入れないでしたが、コンプリートではふつーになんもなかったかのようにそれぞれ3つのコースが無料で使える🫶🏽🫶🏽

私のレビューはこれで以上です!🙂‍↕️説明力がなさすぎるかもしれません💦まだポケ森コンプリートをプレイして数分しか経っていないためレビューは少ないです💦ですがどーしても‼️レビューで素晴らしいということをお伝えしたかったので書かせてもらいました😇もう私の人生ではポケ森コンプリートが必要です……。長い長いレビューでしたがここまで読んでくださりありがとうございます😖😖

title: コンプリート版になってから更に劣化した糞ゲー
text:

title: An amazing game if you’ve got free time... and don’t mind ads
text:
I got Abyssrium a little over a year ago, and I’ve loved it from the start. The art style is beautiful, the gameplay is rewarding, and it’s a great way to spend some extra free time. Ever since last year’s introduction of the new Event Tanks, I’ve enjoyed the game even more, and with events bringing tons of new fish in almost every month, I’m rarely bored. In these ways, Tap Tap Abyssrium is great.

But like any game, it has its issues. With these new monthly events came a new way of playing, one that is unavoidable if you want new event fish. Watching THOUSANDS of ads. To avoid having to wait an entire hour between uses of the event crab, you have to watch an ad, and even with the huge amount of free time I tend to have, waiting that long is out of the question, especially due to the pitiful amount of currency the crab produces each time. Even some of the events hidden fish require you to watch multiple ads just to unlock them. To most people this would probably be extremely annoying, but I’m not that bothered by it, since I just switch to reading a book as soon as I hit that “Watch Ad” button, but that doesn’t mean it’s ok to make the events pretty much impossible to complete without watching hours of ads. I love this game, and participate completely in every event, but with the sheer amount of people who continuously shine light on this huge problem, I’m starting to lost hope for Abyssrium. Please, listen to your faithful fans and show some care for your community.

title: A Game for Anyone to Relax With
text:
I don’t play mobile games as often as I do console games/ports simply because you often get less bang for your buck—not to mention, you won’t get an ad on your Nintendo. It can even be considered a little dishonest to sort of pop up some apps without notice, especially when young ones are playing (and you have a bank account that you don’t want accidentally spent on said apps!). That being said, this is possibly the best and one of the most creative ways I’ve seen ads handled in a mobile game—you’re presented with very short ads but they never pop up unexpectedly and it’s entirely your choice if you want to view them or not. This allows for a great ambiance—which is created by lovely music and adorable graphics—that isn’t interrupted in a startling way. I’ve also found that it’s not impossible to progress past a certain point without viewing ads or without reaching a paywall—ads simply accelerate the process but it is easy to rack up vitality in a day. 

The gameplay is deceptively easy but certainly does become a strategy game as you level up and gain more fish. It can be hard to figure out what to level up and when, adding a nice challenge to an otherwise very simple game. The designs of the fish are interesting and diverse enough to motivate you to collect them, and it’s fun to see how your little biome will change. The event fish are fantastically funky and although the event currency isn’t everyone’s cup of tea (as I’ve read) I personally enjoy it because you can get the event fish without spending vitality, which leaves you with more to buy normal fish with, and to level up the coralite and coral with. 

I’d absolutely recommend this game for anyone who enjoys aquatic life, cute anthropomorphic rocks, or easy breezy relaxing entertainment.

title: Very enjoyable and relaxing,  BUT…
text:
So I’ve been playing it for a couple of days now, and I love the music and sound effects, which I found very ASMR and therefore very soothing. The graphics and color schemes also play a role in making the game feel very Zen overall. However, what I found most tedious is the slow start. 
The player starts with very limited inventory space (5) and will have to keep going back and forth between the main island (player base) and the first available location, where the player can start meeting objectives in order to propel the game. The algorithms of having to keep paying funds to go to the location, catching some fishes (or trash to recycle), and completing objectives make it difficult to progress to just Lvl. 2 because 1) player pays $100 for each trip or the game doesn’t progress at all, 2) your bag can only hold 5 items, 3) the total value of goods the player catches in the beginning barely break even with the $100 spent to get there so  there’s barely any profit left and feels more like a 2-step forward, 1 step back process. Player also has to collect materials to build and upgrade the base, but with so many wood plank requirements just to build the dockyard (which is the first building after the shop and is supposed to be the key to increasing inventory space) and with only 5 slots to put all the fishes, trash, and materials in, the overall feel just feels very imbalanced. 
Other than that, it’s a very adorable game.

title: Baits, Exp, and Lures
text:
I absolutely adore this game, best way to calm down. While I don’t have any problem with the gameplay itself, I think a few things could be improved upon.  
Baits are way too expensive and are unexplained. 4 gems just to catch 5x muskie when attempting American eel for example (inevitably I fished at night and finally caught it🎉). I would suggest that standard and monster bait remain the same. Standard bait could have a little info for new players because at the moment, I still don’t know what it really does. Special bait though should be 1-2 gems vs. 4. The gem grind is really tedious.
Also Exp and the leveling system are confusing. Knowing a skill “path” vs “points” could be better. A path for collecting all fish, larger fish, more currency, easier gameplay, or a more competitive branch. Grinding exp to level up feels useful when you cannot max out your “points” Adding more ways to get loads of exp or changing the system could fix this issue.
Finally, I think that lures should increase the chance of getting that star rank fish. Ex. A lvl 4 lure can catch a lvl 4 fish of that species. 
Thank you for reading and I hope for a response. PS. Being able to change what star lvl of creature you have in an aquarium would be cool too.

title: Great game with great potential
text:
Creatures of the deep is a great game that has the potential to be so much better if the devs listen to the community in terms of additions/changes that need to be made. The game looks amazing and has a fun concept, but there are absolutely some things that could make the game better. First, the game does have a very slow start which I can see deterring people not willing to invest the time into grinding a bit to get to more fun parts of the game. I think starting the game with more inventory slot (or at least making the last few slots more obtainable, 100+ gems is too much) to prevent having to keep from traveling back and forth between home island would help people make profit a little easier. Second, add multiple slots for fishing rods, maybe even one for each rod in the game so you can switch between what you’re fishing for on the fly. Or at least make the slots obtainable through in game progress. Something I think would make the game better would be: better customization. For characters and maybe even being able to personalize your island and invite people to it. Another: fishing together in the same boat working towards objectives together would add to the multiplayer aspect. And one side note for a few quality of life improvements, make an option to re-spec your character attributes and explain specifically what each attribute changes. Have a way to communicate with people in lobby and clan. 

Great game if you like a good balance of relaxing and adventure with excitement. You may not like it if you aren’t into games that require a little grind. Definitely worth the download though.

title: Exactly what I want in a fishing game
text:

I noticed a scientific inaccuracy. In Key West, there is a fish called the Redfish. The term Redfish can refer to many different types of red fish. The model used is that of a red drum (Sciaenops ocellatus). The bio of the fish says it's in the Lutjanidae family when it is actually in the Sciaenidae family. While many Redfish are in the Lutjanidae family, this one is not. This was likely and oversight by the developers and not deliberate spreading of misinformation. Devs, please correct this in a future update/patch.
Another minor inaccuracy is that in the bio for Zander, it says it is in the perciformes order and the esocidae family when the esocidae family is actually in the salmoniformes order. The Zander is actually in the percidae family, but the order was correct as it is a pike-perch (technically a perch) not a pike. Taxonomy is confusing.

title: これって自分だけ？
text:
釣り自体は楽しく、満足しているのですが、不満もあるのでこの評価にさせていただきました。
良い点としては、現実よりも美しく幻想的で釣りの他にもグラフィックで楽しめる。大物は歯応えがあって、燃える。などなど沢山あります

不満な内容としては
・釣りの最中に画面が重くなり、画面が重い間にラインを切られる。設定で画質を低くしてみても効果無し。それが普通の魚だといいのですが、対戦中だったり、レア魚等の大物を釣っている時に重くなるとすぐにラインを切られて逃げらてしまいます。
・ゲームを始めた時に釣りに行けない。
ゲームを始めた時に画面がズーム？されてて釣りに行くための看板を押せません。その時はアプリを再起動させると直るのですが、いちいち面倒くさいのでそこも改善して頂けると嬉しいです。
・無課金には厳しい
無課金だとプレミアム釣り箱の入手方法が基本、ルーレットしかなく強力なロッドが手に入らない。(ダイヤで購入も出来るがダイヤを入手するには基本的に課金)
自分はこのゲームがかなり好きなので今後も長くプレイしたいと思っていますのでこちらの不具合を直していただけると嬉しいです。

title: 面白いけど
