ちょっと進むと深刻なエナジー(スタミナ)不足に襲われます。なんと5分に1ずつしか回復しません。
数時間プレイしてLV13、エナジーがMAX166ですが、全快するのに13時間以上かかります。
魚を1匹釣るのに最低1、最高30エナジーを消費しますが、ストーリーがもっと進むと更に上があるかもしれません。
基本的にはエナジーは10ずつ消費するものだと思いますので、1匹釣るのに50分待たなくてはなりません。
エナジー回復にはちょくちょく貰える10しか回復しないドリンクや貴重なダイヤを消費しなくてはなりません。他にも報酬でエナジーを100とか貰えますが、気がつくと枯渇します。
30秒か1分に1回復ぐらいにしないと、すぐにやめてしまいますね。
早急に改善お願いします。

title: レア魚が釣れないと酷評しているあなた！僕もそうでした。
text:
僕も、酷評しました。
所詮課金竿じゃないと釣れないと、ちゃんと遊びもせずに舐めプして酷評しました。
しかし、ここのレビューを読み、もう一度ちゃんと遊んでみました。
紫の竿でも、今の所全ての魚が釣れます。少なくともT1は全て釣れます。
ただし、ロッドのレベルを50くらいまでは上げる必要があります。
操作に慣れていない方は60台まで上げれば、釣れます。

対戦でも、下手な金竿使いに勝つこともできます。
（対戦はかかる魚の運もありますが）
T1は後半で金竿貰えますが、紫竿が育っているので使っていません。
使わなくとも不自由なくプレイできています。

今後はきっと、スタミナ等渋られるかなと予想されますが、少なくとも今は無課金でも楽しめる、というか、課金する場所が見つからない感じです。

もう一度言います。
僕も最初は、酷評していました。しかもかなり手酷く。
それでもこれくらいのレビューは書けるくらいになったので、カジュアルな釣りゲー好きの方は、諦めずに遊んでみてください。

title: 普通に面白いけど、改善点あり
text:
釣りを趣味にしている人には、操作のリアルさは物足りないかもしれないです。私みたいな素人には、グラフィックも操作性も良くて普通に楽しめます！

1人でコツコツ図鑑を埋めたり大物を釣るも良し、手軽に釣り対決できるのも良い感じです！釣り対決については課金無課金の優劣は多少あると思います。あとはリアル同様に運ゲーな部分はあります。やり込み要素として、そこの差を埋める工夫はできるのであまり気にならないです。

唯一マイナスな点は、エナジーの量が少なすぎて釣りがしたくても待つしかない点です。1回で沢山エネルギー消費するのに、回復アイテムはその1回分相当しか回復できないのはよく分からないです。時間経過の回復も雀の涙程。ユーザーのプレイスタイル的にまとまった時間でやる方が多いと思うので、エナジーの上限アップまたは回復アイテムの強化をお願いします。

以上です。

title: Still Playable!
text:
This app needs an update for sure, but you can progress through the game.  

I am running an iPhone XS and have gotten far in this game. 

Issues:
- Scaling: fish and fisherman are small
- Backgrounds for phone / Fishopedia / Byrdr are unscaled (text is more readable in some of the locales than others depending on the different sky colors)
- Money and gas meter are very small
- Money meter is in the top middle of the screen instead of the far right
- Shop screen is correct scale but the “buy/equip” button is invisible (you can still touch the area under the shop items, about 1/3 from the right, to buy things)
- Store prices are partially obstructed by store items.  (You can drag the first and second item columns down to better see the price) 

The game mechanics still work!  With a little poking around on the store screen, you can buy things that you can afford and make progress. I am nearly finished with the game, in the endgame (5/6 achievements) and working on getting the expensive store items. 

Good luck, and I hope Vlambeer updates this great, CLASSIC iOS game!

title: Best Fishing Game on the App Store
text:
I have spent over $1,000 in games for iOS, and I can say with confidence that I regret 99% of my purchases. This game, however, from the moment I bought it and up to today, has always been worth it. It combines a unique approach to iOS games that rely on movement of your phone with a story that will make you laugh and cry. The story is emotional and well told, but also completely unessential to the gameplay. If you just want that high score, you don’t have to pay attention to the story, because it doesn’t matter! If you want it though, the story is there for you, with it’s loving message about family and redemption. I wouldn’t recommend this game to anyone who wants to play a realistic fishing game, but I would recommend it to anyone who wants to play a fun game that combines the most essential parts of life: fishing, hunting, and family. 

P.S.
There are many clones of this game, please don’t buy them. Ridiculous Fishing was made by the original developers of Radical Fishing, the first game that combined fishing with throwing fish in the air and shooting them. This is the original game, don’t pay for clones!

title: The BEST
text: I got this app years ago and played it once. So, the other day, I’m on hour 4 of a 6 hour plane ride, and I’ve listened to all the music and audiobooks I can tolerate. I’m scrolling through my phone looking for something new and I find this preposterous thing! Two hours later, my wife has to nudge me to say the plane has landed and I have to get off. She thought I’d lost my mind, all the more so when I tried to explain the premise of the game. The thing is, there is no barrier to entry. Any idiot can play instantly. But there’s a lot to learn - rolled out at just the right pace. And no jamming you up for money. What a breath of fresh air! And the humor in the game is just the greatest - no small part of its appeal. This is just perfect for withdrawing from the world yet retaining the ability to rejoin, reluctantly, if needed. The best!!!

title: Once a grand game, languishing for want of an update…
text:
Ridiculously funny game with a good sense of humor. Sadly, the last update “for newer devices” isn’t current, and a lot of screens (like even the 8 plus I’m still using) leave basic UI elements misplaced. Notably, the “buy” element in the store, critical for advancing the storyline at all, isn’t usable.

If you have an old, old device — yeah, older than mine, go for it. Billy’s journey is memorable, and finding the deepest fish to blow sky high is as ridiculous as it gets.

But until this is updated, if you’ve a modern device, you’ll be stuck like me in the shallow end of the pond. Can’t even buy the fishing cap!

title: Why not update it for modern screen sizes?
text:
I played this game years ago and still remember it, pleased to find it again. It is a 5 star game easy but I rate 1 star because the UI is really hard to read with modern phones resolutions and some parts of the game like the store (not in app purchases but in game items which are necessary) are on the verge of breaking as there is no buy button at all you just have to tap the lower half of the screen over and over until you hit where I’m guessing the buy button is supposed to render but it doesn’t.

If this game gets patched for modern phones I’ll give it 5 stars. As it is it seems it might break tomorrow and be unusable. It also doesn’t fit in modern phone screen ratios but has black bars at the top and bottom. If that doesn’t get patched but the UI does, I’ll still rate 5 stars though.

title: Lots of bugs - but good game if fixed.
text: Very fun game, but the amount of bugs makes it almost unplayable. It should either be fixed or taken off the App Store. Item store is messed up. Prices don’t display properly. To buy items you have to click in a blank dialogue box on the right hand side of the screen. When fishing, as you’re reeling up, the screen goes faster than your lure so you eventually can’t even see what fish your getting or not getting. When this happens, eventually the fish explode to the surface, except they don’t, and your trying to shoot fish as they fly up the water column with all the other fish that you didn’t catch. As someone who has paid for this game, please fix glitches, or refund my money. Thank you.

title: Game is absolutely broken. Do not buy.
text:
All banners are too small for a modern phone screen. The visual elements are all completely broken, either the wrong size or just disappearing. The store is completely broken, it’s impossible to purchase anything due to the broken visual effects. This means that any gameplay past the first 25 seconds  is completely blocked off. 

This is easily the second worst $3 I have ever spent, right after paying 3 hobos to kick me in the rear end as hard as they can. The worst part is that once you spend your hard earned money, it is impossible to go to iTunes and get a refund. 

Vlambeer, if you’re reading this, I highly recommend you remove this app from the app store. While this is not quite theft, it is extraordinarily scummy to leave a broken game on the app store while still collecting payment for said game.
